comments.cryptosdream: Dual C&D winner for Jack Jones who enjoyed a consistent spring on the AW; considered

comments.formaladdress: Perhaps the hood will help him settle better; there are risks involved either way
comments.jumpingforjoy: Would want to see good support on today's handicap debut before considering her

comments.spiritlaadelita: String of poor efforts (5f-1m) for three yards and looks of little account
comments.sunsetinparis: Big price when well held from the front (Formal Address behind) at Windsor a fortnight ago
comments.twilightguest: Finally off the mark over C&D last Tuesday; decent claims but has more on under a penalty

verdict.comment: Local Bay remains well treated now back in form. RENESMEE made a solid debut for Michael Keady recently, though, and she shades it.

comments.courtofsession: Made much of the running before fading here on Friday (7f); will need to improve on that
comments.darysinagold: Drop to 1m should suit; finished last in both runs this spring but ought to do much better
comments.localbay: Four wins last summer, latterly off a 7lb higher mark; back in form here lately; player
comments.monkeymiss: Offered little on her comeback for new trainer and has to prove her stamina
comments.renesmee: Stays further, is adaptable regarding tactics and holds obvious claims upped just 1lb

races.raceComment: localbay is confidently preferred with a score of 62.5%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and superior course form and more progressive over renesmee. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 2 wins from 18 starts in similar conditions. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Having gone close at Nottingham in April on her final run for the Crisford stable, LADY MARIKO is taken to get off the mark.

comments.cattonlady: Beaten a long way on reappearance but may have needed it & she's down to a dangerous mark
comments.clasina: 0-12 but has run really well on two of her three starts this season; knocking at the door
comments.emilypost: Fly-leapt leaving stalls when well beaten at Beverley but in good form earlier this year
comments.grovelybelle: Displayed ability last August/September but down the field in all three handicaps
comments.kissmemylove: Returned to form when third at Hamilton; pedigree provides hope about this step up to 7f
comments.kristalklear: Two 7f AW wins last August/September but below par in February on sole run this season
comments.ladymariko: Went close on final outing for the Crisfords and could be involved on stable debut
comments.oneofourown: Yet to prove she stays 7f but it's worth another go and she arrives in pretty good heart
comments.penelopevalentine: Fair 4th at Leicester in April; might not be far away if back on song now in cheekpieces
comments.queensroadrevue: Soundly beaten last week but in good form previously; could be thereabouts if back on song
comments.sixteenone: 0-10 but placed the last twice, going close most recently; a first win may be imminent
comments.straightbackup: Hasn't kicked on from last July's promising debut but still of interest in her first h'cap
comments.sunshinesoul: Promising start to career last summer but not at the same level this year and now 0-9

races.raceComment: queensroadrevue is marginally preferred with a score of 48.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form and superior course form over cattonlady. Placed in 1 of last 6 starts. Likely to be steadily run with pressure on the leader, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: The step up in trip could be a positive for HOMELAND, who kept on for a good second over 1m at Redcar in April.

comments.bettybassett: Yet to threaten but cost 115,000euros and a market check is advised on handicap debut
comments.coverbridge: Won 7f 2yo maiden last June but didn't progress and tailed off on stable debut in April
comments.himself: Fair efforts the last twice but needs something extra to get off the mark at 13th attempt
comments.homeland: Runner-up on handicap debut at Redcar then had an excuse at Doncaster; retains potential
comments.iwantmytimewithyou: Dam was a 1m5f-2m winner and he could be a big improver now up in trip on handicap debut
comments.lightsgodown: Fair 1m2f fourth on the second of his three starts and not discounted on handicap debut
comments.quirkeonparole: Close fourth on handicap debut at Doncaster and that form reads well; on the shortlist
comments.shamador: Went close on debut last September but unable to reproduce that form on his 5 runs since
comments.taylormadelad: Elements of pedigree suggest this step up in trip will suit; not ruled out on h'cap debut
comments.threeonthursday: Has shown ability across her three starts and she's not ruled out on handicap debut
comments.tobytwoscoops: Well beaten at 100-1 on nursery debut at Pontefract last October and absent since

races.raceComment: coverbridge is marginally preferred with a score of 34.3%, holding clear edges in more proven at trip and superior course form and more progressive over homeland. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 2 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, though returning from absence and step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Hold-up mare OPAL STORM (nap) is capable of defying a 3lb rise if getting the breaks. South Shore is another to consider.

comments.carltonandco: Consistent enough, often from the front, but is an infrequent winner; drops from 7f
comments.craftyspirit: Entitled to have needed his recent comeback but didn't offer much hope in finishing last
comments.fortunatestar: Best over 5f and stall 10 isn't ideal for one happiest on the sharp end; bit to overcome
comments.gogoyubari: Well treated again but hasn't offered much in four runs for her new yard
comments.goldenrainbow: Propensity to hang right wouldn't be ideal round here but he enters calculations
comments.kingofthejungle: Would have preferred some rain; share of defeats at short prices in recent times
comments.opalstorm: Hold-up performer who'll always be reliant on some luck; player upped 3lb if getting some
comments.papadontpreach: Useful in the past but usually finds a way of losing these days; capable off this mark
comments.southshore: Found her level again lately; claims if settling better in the first-time hood
comments.therealmckay: 4lb below last winning mark; needs to break better and improve on two previous turf runs

races.raceComment: opalstorm is marginally preferred with a score of 51.5%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form over kingofthejungle. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
